entry_shape_reference._comment: Shape a real graded entry takes (keyed by corpus objection id under grades{}). Empty at launch.
entry_shape_reference._geomean_note: DERIVED from axes at regen (validator recomputes); NOT stored — never copy-forward (band-true discipline).

boundary_policy.field_semantics: Realizes the requested `boundary_cell` flag. Path: grades[<objection>][<depth>].boundary (bool). Also present on entry_shape_reference for schema shape.
boundary_policy.criterion: A cell (objection x depth) is a boundary cell iff its UNROUNDED per-depth geomean lies within `epsilon` of any band line.
boundary_policy.epsilon_basis: 0.010 = one x100 display point ~= the geomean swing produced by a defensible +-0.01 per-axis re-grade applied across the five axes in one direction (d[geomean]/d[axis] ~ geomean/(5*axis) ~ 0.2, so ~5*0.01*0.2 ~ 0.01). Within it the band LETTER is genuinely re-grade-flippable: a judge call.
boundary_policy.epsilon_robustness: The flagged set is stable for any epsilon in (0.0099, 0.0137]: the tightest EXCLUDED cell (dissent-is-misanthropy/long) sits 0.0138 from its line, a clear gap above the tightest INCLUDED cell's slack. The exact epsilon is not knife-edge.
boundary_policy.geomean_basis: UNROUNDED per-depth geomean (band-true, per method{}). Depth modifiers applied before the geomean: medium c-0.05/r-0.03, short c-0.12/r-0.06; long unmodified.
boundary_policy.register: GRADING-contestedness only: `boundary` marks that THE GRADE of the objection's rebuttal is a close call. It is an appraisal of the appraisal — it carries no verdict on the objection's subject matter and implies nothing about any act. Firewall-A (no exhortation) and Firewall-B (appraisal-silence) are untouched.
boundary_policy.scope_note: Tracks band-fragility, NOT dialectical/terminus contestedness (e.g. primitive-concession ceilings, asymmetry-dependence). A cell can be philosophically live yet grade-clear, or grade-fragile yet dialectically settled. A distinct flag would be needed for terminus-contestedness; not requested here.
boundary_policy.node_level_collapse_warning: Do NOT collapse to a per-node bool for this wing: all 6 nodes have >=1 boundary depth, so a node-level flag is vacuous (true for every node). The signal exists only at DEPTH granularity. Consume grades[id][depth].boundary, not a node aggregate.
boundary_policy.supersedes_S14: Captures both cells S14 identified (privilege-tracks-a-capacity/medium, dissent-is-misanthropy/medium) plus 5 more A/B-seam cells S14's tighter display-proximity heuristic missed.
